prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: source sheet for a small transparent animated icon on a fashion workflow website
Primary request: Create one square image made of EXACTLY four equal square tiles in a precise 2x2 grid. Each tile depicts the SAME premium miniature marker-making scene in four successive motion phases: several softly sculpted white paper pattern pieces arranged on a rectangular piece of white fabric. One sleeve-like piece glides into a useful gap between larger pattern pieces, improving the nest and reducing unused fabric. Phase 1: pieces are apart with a clear gap. Phase 2: small piece slides toward the gap. Phase 3: pieces nest efficiently together. Phase 4: small piece returns slightly toward the first position. Clearly communicate garment marker layout and fabric utilization.
Scene/backdrop: transparent beyond the fabric swatch.
Subject: one small rectangular fabric sheet and exactly three paper garment pattern shapes with softly raised seam allowance details.
Style/medium: premium charming white-clay/paper miniature fashion illustration, tactile matte white fabric and paper, pale neutral-grey dimensional shading, soft friendly craftsmanship, sophisticated not vector.
Composition/framing: fixed top-down camera, same scale, lighting and centered placement each tile, ample transparent margin around the rectangular swatch, exact 2x2 panels and no visible borders or dividers.
Lighting/mood: soft studio light, restrained natural shadows and highlights.
Color palette: white and pale neutral grey only, true transparent background outside the subject.
Materials/textures: lightly woven fabric, fine matte paper pieces, subtle raised seam details and soft rounded edges.
Text (verbatim): none.
Constraints: four coherent sequential motion phases of the same objects; keep the exact number and identity of pieces and camera unchanged; preserve alpha transparency.
Avoid: scissors, hands, people, extra tools, colors, beige, black backdrop, text, numbers, logo, watermark, panel outlines, grid, borders, crop, perspective change, crude vector line art.
